mapper.select: SELECT id, folder_id, item_type, target_id, knowledge_id, blog_id, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_favorite_item WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND item_type = 'knowledge' AND target_id = #{knowledgeId} AND (deleted IS NULL OR deleted = 0) LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id, i.folder_id, i.item_type, i.target_id, i.knowledge_id, i.blog_id, i.sort, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM sys_favorite_item i LEFT JOIN sys_knowledge k ON i.item_type = 'knowledge' AND i.target_id = k.id LEFT JOIN sys_blog b ON i.item_type = 'blog' AND i.target_id = b.id WHERE i.folder_id = #{folderId} AND (i.deleted IS NULL OR i.deleted = 0)
AND ( k.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.name, f.description, f.user_id, f.is_public, f.cover_image, f.item_count, f.view_count, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM sys_favorite_folder f INNER JOIN sys_favorite_item i ON f.id = i.folder_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND i.item_type = 'knowledge' AND i.target_id = #{knowledgeId} AND (f.deleted IS NULL OR f.deleted = 0) AND (i.deleted IS NULL OR i.deleted = 0) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
